messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday falling on a Friday or a Monday (the holiday itself plus the adjacent weekend days).  (If a holiday falls on a Tuesday–Thursday, it does not automatically create a long weekend unless you take extra days off.)

| Long Weekend | Holiday (Federal) | Dates Covered | Notes |
|--------------|-------------------|---------------|-------|
| **Family Day** | Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island | **Feb 18–20** | Family Day is observed on the 3rd Monday of February in most provinces. |
| **Good Friday** | All provinces | **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in every province. |
| **Victoria Day** | All provinces | **May 20–22** | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 25. |
| **Civic Holiday** | Ontario, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland & Labrador | **Aug 5–7** | Observed on the first Monday in August (except Quebec). |
| **Labour Day** | All provinces | **Sep 2–4** | First Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | All provinces | **Oct 7–9** | Second Monday in October. |
| **Remembrance Day** | All provinces | **Nov 9–11** | Observed on the last Monday in November. |
| **Christmas Day** | All provinces | **Dec 23–25** | Christmas falls on a Monday in 2023. |

### Quick Summary

- **8 long weekends** in 2023 that were guaranteed by federal holidays falling on a Friday or Monday.  
- If you’re in a province that observes **Family Day** (e.g., Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, PEI), you’ll have an extra long weekend in February.  
- Some provinces have additional holidays that can create long weekends if you take adjacent days off (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on March 17, but it falls on a Wednesday, so it doesn’t automatically create a long weekend).

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific holidays beyond the federal ones, let me know and I can add those too.
